        Data

        Elevation: real data only. Cook Inlet (60.8–61.6° N, 149.3–151° W) uses USGS 3DEP 3″ on land, Copernicus GLO-30 where 3DEP has no land value, and ETOPO 2022 15″ for the sea floor. Everywhere else uses the global base, NOAA ETOPO 2022 0.5° (about 56 km cells).
